description: This file implements the ListView functionality for the Vtiger CRM module, handling list display, sorting, filtering, custom views, permissions, and navigation.

classes.name: CustomView
classes.description: Handles custom view management including view IDs, permissions, and view options.

classes.name: QueryGenerator
classes.description: Generates database queries for listing records based on filters, views, and sorting.

classes.name: ListViewController
classes.description: Controls the retrieval and display of list view data, headers, and entries.

methods.name: initForCustomViewById
methods.description: Initializes query generator for a specific custom view ID.

methods.name: initForDefaultCustomView
methods.description: Initializes query generator for the default view.

methods.name: addUserSearchConditions
methods.description: Adds user search conditions to the query based on request parameters.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Returns the SQL query string for listing records.

methods.name: getConditionalWhere
methods.description: Returns the WHERE clause conditions for filtering.
